record.question: Increasing the mA alone causes:
options: no significant change in xray beam characteristics
increases the hardness/ penetrating property of the xray beam
increased photon production and not penetration
increases the photon production and penetration
record.explanation: Answer C: increased photon production and not penetration. Increasing tube current alone increases photon quantity, without materially increasing beam energy/penetration. Reference: https://www.nist.gov/pml/periodic-table-elements; https://aerb.gov.in/english/radiation-protection-principle. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
